translations.web: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.
translations.bsb: Yet by His power, God drags away the mighty; though rising up, they have no assurance of life.
translations.kjv: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
translations.asv: Yet God preserveth the mighty by his power: He riseth up that hath no assurance of life.
